title: Involvement of beta-catenin in Androgen-induced Mesenchymal Transition of Breast MDA-MB-453 Cancer Cells.
authors: Ahram, Mamoun; Bawadi, Randa; Abdullah, Mohammad S; Alsafadi, Dana B; Abaza, Haneen; Abdallah, Sallam; Mustafa, Ebtihal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究雄激素诱导乳腺癌细胞EMT中β-catenin与AR的蛋白互作，但核心是细胞表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Purpose The cellular and molecular dynamics of DHT-induced EMT in MDA-MB-453 cells were investigated.Methods:PCR arrays were used to examine the expression of EMT-regulatory genes. Immunoblotting was used to detect protein levels and confirm protein-protein interaction following immunoprecipitation. Immunofluorescence was used to observe rearrangement of the actin cytoskeleton and cell morphology. Cell migration was assessed by transwell assayResults: Change of cell morphology was concomitant with increased cell migration after treating cells with DHT. Exposure of cells to DHT for one hour was sufficient to induce changes in cell morphology and actin cytoskeleton after 72 hours indicating altered gene expression. A long-term lasting nuclear translocation of AR was observed after a short exposure of cells to DHT. Investigating the expression of 84 EMT-related genes revealed down-expression of beta-catenin, N-cadherin, and TCF-4 and increased expression of Slug, all of which were confirmed at the protein level. Yet, not only early interaction of AR and beta-catenin was observed following AR activation, inhibition of beta-catenin blocked DHT-induced mesenchymal transition and migration. Wnt signaling was found to be partially important in DHT-induced morphological alteration. The mesenchymal transition of cells could be induced by treating cells with an inhibitor of glycogen synthase kinase-3beta, an enzyme that inhibits beta-catenin; this morphological transition could be reversed by antagonizing AR suggesting that AR functions downstream of beta-catenin.Conclusions: These results suggest that MDA-MB-453 cells undergo partial EMT induced by DHT, beta-catenin is critical for this phenotypic change, and AR probably reciprocally mediates the mesenchymal transition of these cells upon activation of GSK-3 beta.
abstract_zh: 目的：研究了DHT诱导的MDA-MB-453细胞中上皮-间质转化（EMT）的细胞和分子动力学。方法：使用PCR阵列检测EMT调控基因的表达。免疫印迹用于检测蛋白水平并确认免疫沉淀后的蛋白-蛋白相互作用。免疫荧光用于观察肌动蛋白细胞骨架的重排和细胞形态。通过transwell实验评估细胞迁移。结果：用DHT处理细胞后，细胞形态的变化与细胞迁移增加同时发生。将细胞暴露于DHT一小时足以在72小时后诱导细胞形态和肌动蛋白细胞骨架的变化，表明基因表达发生了改变。在细胞短暂暴露于DHT后，观察到AR的长期核转位。对84个EMT相关基因表达的研究显示，β-连环蛋白、N-钙粘蛋白和TCF-4表达下调，而Slug表达增加，所有这些均在蛋白水平得到确认。然而，不仅在AR激活后观察到AR与β-连环蛋白的早期相互作用，抑制β-连环蛋白还阻断了DHT诱导的间质转化和迁移。Wnt信号在DHT诱导的形态改变中被发现部分重要。通过用糖原合成酶激酶-3β（一种抑制β-连环蛋白的酶）的抑制剂处理细胞，可诱导细胞的间质转化；这种形态转化可通过拮抗AR而逆转，表明AR在β-连环蛋白下游发挥作用。结论：这些结果表明，MDA-MB-453细胞经历由DHT诱导的部分EMT，β-连环蛋白对此表型变化至关重要，且AR可能在GSK-3β激活后相互介导这些细胞的间质转化。
